DACI Youth

Adolescent Crisis Prevention, Assessment, De-Escalation & Therapeutic Support

Build a shared approach to recognizing distress, responding calmly, and supporting young people through difficult moments. Practice communication and prevention strategies within a hands-off policy.

← All DACI programs
Youth & Adolescent Support • Hands-Off

Who this program is for

Educators, behavioral health professionals, residential treatment staff, juvenile care providers, and other youth-serving teams.

Developmentally appropriate, trauma-informed support without physical intervention techniques.

Learning outcomes

  • Identify early distress and assess behavioral risk.
  • Match supportive responses to the level of escalation.
  • Use calm communication and respectful limits.
  • Choose non-physical strategies that support safety.
  • Restore rapport and learn together after an incident.

Inside the program

Curriculum & Learning Modules

A practical overview of the topics covered in this DACI program.

MODULE 01

Distress, behavior & risk

Explore how perceived threats and stress can affect behavior; identify opportunities for prevention.

MODULE 02

Recognizing escalation

Practice noticing changes in behavior and choosing a supportive response.

MODULE 03

The influence of adult responses

Consider underlying causes and how staff behavior can shape an interaction.

MODULE 04

Supportive communication

Prepare for difficult conversations using clear, calm, respectful communication.

MODULE 05

Responding to resistance

Practice limits and communication strategies matched to the situation.

MODULE 06

Hands-off safety decisions

Use verbal and environmental responses that fit the assessed risk.

MODULE 07

Recovery & reflective practice

Rebuild rapport after a crisis and identify improvements for future support.
